realistic-gm-screen.settings.enabled.hin: When enabled, the module adds player-facing cover messages for GM private rolls and total-only messages for GM blind rolls.
realistic-gm-screen.settings.privateStub: Cover messages for GM private rolls
Players see only a rough amount of dice rolled, without formula, die sizes, die values, or modifiers.
realistic-gm-screen.settings.blindResult: Players see only the final total of a GM blind roll, without formula, die values, or bonuses.
realistic-gm-screen.settings.audience.hi: Public: everyone sees the message. Players only: the message is whispered to non-GM users.
realistic-gm-screen.settings.debug.name: Debug logging
realistic-gm-screen.settings.debug.hint: Write GM Screen roll detection details to the browser console. Leave disabled during normal play.
realistic-gm-screen.privateStub.title: Roll behind the screen
realistic-gm-screen.playerBlindStub.line: {name} rolled dice blindly behind the GM screen.
